name: Ice giants

variantInfo.name: Ice giant
notes: Standard ice giant; spawns at the Frozen Waste Plateau in the Wilderness (9 spawns).
Ice giants also spawn in non-Wilderness dungeons, but Krystilia counts only the Wilderness kills.

variantInfo.name: Ice giant
notes: Higher-level ice giant variant found only in the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
Grants more Slayer XP (100) than the standard variant.
The cave is multicombat and cannonable but a popular player-killing hotspot.

variantInfo.name: Eldric the Ice King
notes: Counts for Ice giants assigned by Vannaka. Krystilia requires Wilderness kills, so this arena does not qualify.
The full Royal Titans encounter also requires fighting Branda, but Ice giant task damage bonuses and credit apply only to Eldric.
Combat NPC14147 is the target; defeated loot NPC14149 is not a combat variant.

locationComparison.name: Frozen Waste Plateau
notes: 9 ice giant spawns in the western Wilderness (around level 50).
Single-way combat but cannonable and safespottable per the wiki Location Comparison.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave (ice giants)
notes: 14 spawns of the combat level 67 variant; multicombat, cannonable and safespottable per the wiki Location Comparison.
A popular player-killing hotspot; keep near one-click teleport range.

locationComparison.name: Royal Titans
notes: Eldric counts for Vannaka Ice giant assignments. Fight both Royal Titans using the shared complete encounter preparation.
The encounter has no access requirements and supports solo or duo play. It is outside the Wilderness and cannot satisfy Krystilia assignments.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 261 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Ice giants is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
Krystilia assigns ice giants as a Wilderness-only task; only Wilderness ice giant kills (Frozen Waste Plateau or Wilderness Slayer Cave) count.
Ice giants are weak to fire (100%); fire spells and any melee are effective given their very low defence.
The Wilderness Slayer Cave holds a higher-level combat level 67 variant that grants 100 Slayer XP and is multicombat/cannonable.
Vannaka assignments can instead be completed at Eldric the Ice King in the Royal Titans encounter. Ice giant task buffs do not apply to Branda; both bosses must still be fought.
recommendedMethod: Kill ice giants at the Frozen Waste Plateau or, for faster XP with a cannon, the level 67 variant in the Wilderness Slayer Cave. Ice giants have very low defence, so any strong melee weapon (or fire spells) works; wear low-risk Wilderness gear and keep a one-click escape teleport ready. On a Vannaka assignment, Eldric the Ice King is a boss alternative; use the shared Royal Titans preparation and bring all required combat styles.
